title: P2 secret.revoke: request
description: Revocation of a secret on compromise (farmctl secret revoke --compromised, SEC-6). A credential that the core issued (a worker token, a program key, a handle) stops working from the next call without an overlap window. In the same operation the core sets a hold without expiry with reason compromised on every scope where the deployment description uses the secret; only the operator releases it (HLD-2).

secret.description: Name of the deployment secret or of a credential that the core issued.

compromised.description: Only the compromise path; a planned rotation uses the overlap window.
